3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: As the morning sun cast its golden rays over the portrait-lined halls of the palace, I waited for Duke Reinhart to arrive.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: The meeting, a follow-up on our recent Aureus gas field agreement, was crucial in solidifying our newfound cooperation.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: I paced the grand reception hall, looking at its walls adorned with tapestries depicting the glorious history of Rizia, while Pabel was making sure everything was in order.

6.speaker: Pabel Adria
6.text: "What are you thinking? About that map, I mean."

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I stopped in front of one massive tapestry map dated from the 7th century, which showed the Rezenid Empire at the height of its power.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: The borders stretched far and wide, including most of the current territories of current-day Morella, Derdia, Wehlen and the southern coasts of Lespia.

9.speaker: Player_Romus
9.text: "I was just thinking how much territory we've lost throughout the last centuries."

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "Nothing. I was just checking it out."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "Do you think it's too aggressive? Having this in the reception hall?"

14.speaker: Pabel Adria
14.text: "I'm not so sure about that. Few threads still link the ancient Rezenid Empire and modern-day Rizia."

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: He pointed at one map, hung in the corner of the hall.

18.speaker: Pabel Adria
18.text: "Don't you think that particular map might be perceived a bit... negatively?"

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: It was a very rare map depicting the borders of the kingdom in the 18th century, showing Pales as part of Rizia.

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "You have a point, actually. Why did nobody notice this? Where the hell is Mr. Esquibel?"

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "You're right. The Duke may take it the wrong way. Take it down."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "That's absurd. It's just a map on a wall. The Duke wouldn't be offended by such a trivial thing."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "Even better. I want him to see that Pales was, and must be, Rizian territory."

24.speaker: Pabel Adria
24.text: "He'll be welcoming our guest. Should I take it down?"

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: Pabel signaled to a pair of nearby servants. A few minutes later, they returned with a ladder and swiftly removed the map.

33.speaker: Narrator
33.text: Suddenly, we heard a knock on the door, signalling the arrival of the Duke.

34.speaker: Pabel Adria
34.text: "I will leave you to it. I hope it's a very productive meeting."

38.speaker: Narrator
38.text: Before I had time to recollect myself, the doors suddenly opened.

39.speaker: Narrator
39.text: Duke Reinhart strode into the hall, glancing around at the paintings and tapestries on the walls.

40.speaker: Narrator
40.text: He approached me and we shook hands.

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "At last, we meet on my territory. I hope you enjoyed the ride."

45.speaker: Axel Reinhart
45.text: "It's great to be here, Your Majesty."

48.speaker: Narrator
48.text: He smiled and gestured at the pair of armchairs that had been set out for us.

53.speaker: Axel Reinhart
53.text: "So, Your Majesty... I hope you've been faring well since we last met."

54.speaker: Axel Reinhart
54.text: "I must say the Aureus field has been a game-changer for us, now that extractions have begun in earnest."

61.speaker: Axel Reinhart
61.text: "From the reports LesPower is sending me, it's been quite the boon to your industries as well."
61.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_PalesPipeline_Completed"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) == false)

62.speaker: Axel Reinhart
62.text: "I'd say we both made out like bandits, wouldn't you?"

63.speaker: Axel Reinhart
63.text: "From the reports I've been reading, Rizia should start reaping the rewards any moment now."

67.speaker: Axel Reinhart
67.text: "From the reports Rizian Oil and Gas is sending me, it's been quite the boon to your industries and foreign trade as well."

68.speaker: Axel Reinhart
68.text: "Your industries get a boost, our energy exports soar to new levels. Quite a win-win, wouldn't you say?"

69.speaker: Axel Reinhart
69.text: "From the reports I've been reading, we'll have plenty to sell you once the PaleStream pipeline is finished."

70.speaker: Axel Reinhart
70.text: "I'm looking forward to hammering out the details."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "Absolutely. The gas deal has been pivotal for us."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "I'm hoping to see its direct results on our economy."

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "Yes. Your support has been invaluable. But there's always room for growth."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "It will be even better once our deals with our other energy partners are completed."

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "That's great news. Rizia looks forward to receiving Palesian gas."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "Thank you for taking care of the pipeline, Your Grace. But there's always room for growth, right?"

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "I hope we can reach a resolution like we did before."

81.speaker: Axel Reinhart
81.text: "Growth? Of course. We both have much to discuss."

82.speaker: Axel Reinhart
82.text: "With your diplomatic attitude, I'm sure we will."

86.speaker: Axel Reinhart
86.text: "If we could make it through our recent mishap without going to war, we can reach a resolution on anything."

87.speaker: Axel Reinhart
87.text: "Yes. We can begin as soon as the pipeline is complete."

88.speaker: Axel Reinhart
88.text: "Oh, yes. With luck, this energy partnership is only the beginning."

89.speaker: Axel Reinhart
89.text: "Right, yes... Prime Minister Alvarez will be getting in touch with you about that."

90.speaker: Axel Reinhart
90.text: "Oh you will, Your Majesty. I'm surprised you haven't yet."

95.speaker: Axel Reinhart
95.text: "Your Majesty, we are very excited to be able to supply Rizia with energy from our gas field."
95.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Friendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Allied"] == true)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true)) == false)

98.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
98.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Friendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Allied"] == true)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true)

99.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
99.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Friendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Allied"] == true)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true)) == false

100.speaker: Axel Reinhart
100.text: "In light of this, I've been contemplating the future, you know. Our next steps..."

101.speaker: Axel Reinhart
101.text: "I believe the resolution we reached, and the crises we've shepherded each other through together, amount to more than just handshakes or numbers."

105.speaker: Axel Reinhart
105.text: "I believe the resolution we reached amounts to more than just handshakes or numbers."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "And what might that be, Your Grace?"

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "Our nations have been at this diplomatic dance for a while now. What are you hinting at?"

108.speaker: Player_Romus
108.text: "I agree wholeheartedly. That resolution was a sign of a deeper understanding between our countries. We can't stop there."

110.speaker: Axel Reinhart
110.text: "...And I'm wondering whether Rizia is ready to go all in on this *good neighbor* thing."

111.speaker: Axel Reinhart
111.text: "I'm not hinting at anything yet. I just want to hear what the King of Rizia thinks."

115.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
115.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Unfriendly"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Hostile"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Duke_AskedGRACE"] == false) == false

116.speaker: Axel Reinhart
116.text: "I'm just wondering whether Rizia is ready to take this whole *good neighbor* thing to the next level."

119.speaker: Axel Reinhart
119.text: "I believe the resolution we reached and the crises we've been through together amount to more than just handshakes or numbers."
119.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Friendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Allied"] == true)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true)) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true)

123.speaker: Axel Reinhart
123.text: "I believe the resolution we reached amounts to more than just handshakes or numbers."
123.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Friendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Allied"] == true)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true)) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true) == false)

124.speaker: Axel Reinhart
124.text: "Naturally, I'd like to keep things civil -- and profitable -- between our nations."

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "You should know by now that this is more than a 'good neighbor thing'."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "We've already achieved a lot. I don't know how we can do more, to be honest."

128.speaker: Axel Reinhart
128.text: "Great. I like the way you think."

129.speaker: Axel Reinhart
129.text: "We've been circling around this for years. I told you I've been trying to get Pales out from under Lespia's thumb."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "I don't know if I can offer anything else to Pales without a gas deal, Your Grace. We relinquished our entire claim for you already."

137.speaker: Axel Reinhart
137.text: "Then perhaps it's time we talk about that."

138.speaker: Axel Reinhart
138.text: "As you know, our partners in LesPower took it upon themselves to build all the necessary infrastructure as a token of gratitude."

139.speaker: Axel Reinhart
139.text: "Soon, PaleStream will be able to transfer all the natural gas your kingdom could possibly demand..."

140.speaker: Axel Reinhart
140.text: "If everything goes to plan, it will be ready at the end of this year."

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "Good to know, Your Grace. But you're being evasive. What are your terms?"

144.speaker: Player_Romus
144.text: "You'd better offer us the best discount you can give."

146.speaker: Narrator
146.text: There was a brief silence, his expression thoughtful. He smiled.

150.speaker: Axel Reinhart
150.text: "Sure. Who doesn't want a piece of Aureus?"

151.speaker: Axel Reinhart
151.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Friendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Allied"] == true)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true)

155.speaker: Player_Romus
155.text: "Exactly. I had some ideas I've been wanting to discuss with you myself."

162.speaker: Narrator
162.text: After our peaceful withdrawal of our claim to the Aureus field, the Palesian leader had signaled his interest in selling gas to Rizia. Our meeting today would be crucial in determining the future of our partnership.
162.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] >= 1  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) == false)

163.speaker: Narrator
163.text: He was in Rizia to inspect our end of the Palestream pipeline and meet with industry leaders.
163.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] >= 1  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_AureusDeal_PipelineOpening"] == true)

167.speaker: Narrator
167.text: He was in Rizia to inspect the construction of the Palestream pipeline and meet with industry leaders.
167.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] >= 1  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_AureusDeal_PipelineOpening"] == true) == false)

168.speaker: Narrator
168.text: While he was here, he had decided to pay me a visit as well.

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "What do you think about the pipeline?"

177.speaker: Axel Reinhart
177.text: "I was told it's an engineering masterpiece."

178.speaker: Axel Reinhart
178.text: "Quite amazing, really. And proceeding at lightning speed."

179.speaker: Axel Reinhart
179.text: "I was told it is going to be an engineering masterpiece."

180.speaker: Axel Reinhart
180.text: "I believe that's everything I came here to discuss."
180.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Duke_SellGas"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true)

181.speaker: Axel Reinhart
181.text: "How about you, Your Majesty? Do you have anything to share with me?"

185.speaker: Axel Reinhart
185.text: "Perhaps it's time to talk about our energy deal."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "I do. I have an offer for you."

189.speaker: Player_Romus
189.text: "I don't really see a need to discuss anything. We've cooperated enough already."

196.speaker: Axel Reinhart
196.text: "Come on, Your Majesty. Is your imagination that limited?"

197.speaker: Player_Romus
197.text: "Under Lespia's terms and conditions, you mean."

198.speaker: Axel Reinhart
198.text: "Well, LesPower has the control, yes. That's why I'm only the messenger at this moment."

199.speaker: Axel Reinhart
199.text: "As soon as PaleStream starts pumping out gas from Aureus, it will be relatively affordable to transport it into Rizia."

200.speaker: Axel Reinhart
200.text: "Having said that, Rizia will be paying 12.50 Arcasian Liras per thousand cubic meters."

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "I was expecting a discount, not a damn scam."

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "Over 12 Arcasian Liras? That's the most expensive energy in South Merkopa."

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "No, Your Grace. I did not withdraw Rizia's claim for this. I'll pay the market average for this gas, but no more."

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "That seems reasonable to me." [-4 Budget per Turn for +2 Energy per Turn]

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "With that price, I'm only willing to make a short-term deal. We'll order energy for this year alone."  [-3 Budget for +2 Energy]

212.speaker: Player_Romus
212.text: "That's not reasonable. We don't have the budget to pay for that."

213.speaker: Axel Reinhart
213.text: "This is the price defined by LesPower, Your Majesty. As you know, they're the ones handling the logistics."

216.speaker: Axel Reinhart
216.text: "There is nothing I can do about that right now."

217.speaker: Player_Romus
217.text: "Fine. It's a deal." [-4 Budget per Turn for +2 Energy per Turn]

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "A short-term deal is all I can agree to right now. We'll order energy for this year alone." [-3 Budget for +2 Energy]

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "This is a direct consequence of your willingness to hand your Grand Duchy's reins to Lespia, Your Grace. Fearing Rizia, you dealt with the devil instead."

226.speaker: Player_Romus
226.text: "You're the one with the deed to the gas field, Your Grace. We can help you get away from Lespia's control."

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "Sorry, Your Grace. I cannot buy energy for this price. This is ridiculous."

228.speaker: Axel Reinhart
228.text: "Perhaps you can convince Mr. Alvarez to go lower."

229.speaker: Axel Reinhart
229.text: "I won't argue with that. But it's LesPower's decision."

230.speaker: Axel Reinhart
230.text: "Oh, please. We've had this conversation already."

231.speaker: Axel Reinhart
231.text: "You know exactly what I think of Lespia. But they provide us with protection, technology and the know-how to kickstart our own energy industries."

232.speaker: Axel Reinhart
232.text: "So Rizia is willing to take on all of the contracts Lespia has with us?"

234.speaker: Player_Romus
234.text: "If you want to have that discussion, I'm ready for it."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "Be reasonable, Your Grace. Of course we cannot provide everything Lespia offers. But we can offer you other unique benefits."

239.speaker: Axel Reinhart
239.text: "And now that we've entrusted Rizia with our energy instead of Lespia, our futures have become inextricably intertwined."

243.speaker: Axel Reinhart
243.text: "And now that Rizia has gained our trust, it might be possible for us to reconsider certain agreements with Lespia -- provided that you can offer an alternative."

244.speaker: Axel Reinhart
244.text: "I would like Rizia to help Pales join GRACE."

247.speaker: Axel Reinhart
247.text: "I understand. You must be very busy."

251.speaker: Axel Reinhart
251.text: "I'd like to believe so. Apart from the incident we shall not speak of, your kingdom's actions have been more than reconciliatory."

252.speaker: Axel Reinhart
252.text: "I also believe Rizia and Pales are natural partners. Our countries are politically and culturally the closest in Southern Merkopa -- maybe even the whole world."

253.speaker: Narrator
253.text: He paused and gave me an intense stare, as if he was expecting me to cut in with an offer.

254.speaker: Player_Romus
254.text: "As a matter of fact, I have an offer for you."

258.speaker: Narrator
258.text: He glanced around the hall for a few seconds before his eyes landed back on me.

259.speaker: Axel Reinhart
259.text: "Pulling away from Lespia will necessitate strong allies -- with common goals."

266.speaker: Axel Reinhart
266.text: "One moment, Your Majesty. Please hear me out."

271.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
271.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Border_KillSoldiers"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_NoRescue"] == true) == false

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "Are you serious? Rizia has paid your Grand Duchy too much already."

276.speaker: Player_Romus
276.text: "Are you serious? Not only did we cede our claim, you ended up destroying our flagship. Now this?"
276.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Border_KillSoldiers"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_NoRescue"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_RescueBoth"] == true)

278.speaker: Axel Reinhart
278.text: "You know exactly what I think of Lespia. But they provide us with protection, technology and the know-how to kickstart our own energy industries."

279.speaker: Axel Reinhart
279.text: "I don't know. Isn't it a little late?"

280.speaker: Narrator
280.text: I saw a glint in his eye.

281.speaker: Axel Reinhart
281.text: "You had your chance. If Rizia had bought the rights to Aureus like we offered, neither of us would be in this situation."

282.speaker: Axel Reinhart
282.text: "Unfortunately, for the time being, you'll have to directly deal with Lespia when it comes to your energy prices."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "What? Do you want me to censor history just because our guest finds it offensive?"

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "Mr. Alvarez sent you to do his bidding and you agreed, did you not?"

287.speaker: Axel Reinhart
287.text: "I... I refuse to comply with this line of questioning."

289.speaker: Player_Romus
289.text: "It seems neither of us are given the respect we deserve, Your Grace. Maybe you should finally open your eyes to what Lespia really is."

291.speaker: Player_Romus
291.text: "This is a direct consequence of your willingness to give control of your country to Lespia, Your Grace. Fearing Rizia, you dealt with the devil instead."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "You're the one with the deed to the gas field, Your Grace. We can help you get away from Lespia's control."

297.speaker: Axel Reinhart
297.text: "All right. That's more than enough, Your Majesty."

298.speaker: Axel Reinhart
298.text: "Well... Before we go there, let's talk about Aureus."

299.speaker: Narrator
299.text: He looked like he was going to say something, but then stopped himself.

300.speaker: Axel Reinhart
300.text: "I know exactly what Lespia is. But they provide us with protection, technology and the know-how to kickstart our own energy industries."

307.speaker: Axel Reinhart
307.text: "And now that Rizia has gained our trust, it might be a possibility to reconsider certain agreements with Lespia -- provided that there is an alternative offer from our new partners."

309.speaker: Axel Reinhart
309.text: "I believe I've said everything I needed to."

313.speaker: Player_Romus
313.text: "I have nothing left to offer you."

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "I understand. But you and I seem to be at an impasse."

319.speaker: Narrator
319.text: He stood up and shook my hand.

320.speaker: Axel Reinhart
320.text: "Thanks for having me, Your Majesty. It was a pleasure as always."

321.speaker: Axel Reinhart
321.text: "Rizia is a key member. Have you considered extending an invitation our way?"

322.speaker: Player_Romus
322.text: "Actually, I've been waiting to talk to you about this myself. I want to see Pales as part of GRACE. Our monarchies must stand together."
322.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_AskedQueen_Pales_Grace"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Unfriendly"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Hostile"] == false)

323.speaker: Player_Romus
323.text: "I do not support the membership of Pales in GRACE."

324.speaker: Player_Romus
324.text: "I want to pursue an alliance with Pales -- but I don't believe GRACE is the right way to do this, Your Grace. We should build ties with each other without Rumburg or Lespia's interference."

325.speaker: Player_Romus
325.text: "I can invite an extension but I'm afraid I cannot make the decision myself. The member states must conduct a vote to allow a new member."

329.speaker: Player_Romus
329.text: "As a matter of fact, I've recently discussed this very topic with Queen Beatrice. Rumburg would love for Pales to become a GRACE member."

332.speaker: Axel Reinhart
332.text: "I'm so glad to hear you agree."

333.speaker: Axel Reinhart
333.text: "Of course. I cannot ask for more than an invitation."

334.speaker: Axel Reinhart
334.text: "So, can I expect you to advocate for our membership at the next GRACE meeting?"

336.speaker: Axel Reinhart
336.text: "I can't help but wonder if this is what you really want, or if Her Excellency Queen Beatrice is squeezing you out of her club."

338.speaker: Player_Romus
338.text: "I don't think Pales belongs in GRACE."

339.speaker: Player_Romus
339.text: "Given the geopolitical situation and your close ties with the Lespians, GRACE members would never accept you."

340.speaker: Player_Romus
340.text: "I think we can do better than GRACE."

341.speaker: Narrator
341.text: He raised his eyebrow, his curiosity piqued.

345.speaker: Axel Reinhart
345.text: "You're really saying this, after going through all that trouble?"

346.speaker: Axel Reinhart
346.text: "Oh, please, Your Majesty. You're saying that because you don't want us to be part of it. You still don't trust Pales."

347.speaker: Player_Romus
347.text: "Yes. We will bring it up to the members and initiate your application."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "Not so fast. What's in it for us if we put in a good word with Queen Beatrice?"

349.speaker: Player_Romus
349.text: "Yes. But I expect you to stop all of your partnerships with Lespia."

352.speaker: Player_Romus
352.text: "It's time we stand together. I'm offering you a military alliance. Rizia can give you the protection you require. You won't need Lespia anymore."

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "I envision a grander alliance that encompasses our neighbors in Southern Merkopa. We have to protect this region from encroaching world powers. If you and I work together, we can achieve this."

354.speaker: Player_Romus
354.text: "Why don't you join GRACE? I want to finally see Pales stand with us."

356.speaker: Axel Reinhart
356.text: "Tell me. What would this new alliance look like?"

357.speaker: Axel Reinhart
357.text: "Well. If you're not going to help us, I suppose we'll just have to apply for membership on our own."

358.speaker: Player_Romus
358.text: "Which GRACE nation is going to help Pales if not Rizia? Do you think Beatrice gives a damn about what happens in your country?"

359.speaker: Player_Romus
359.text: "Listen to me, Reinhart. You and I can do better than GRACE."

362.speaker: Axel Reinhart
362.text: "I must say, it's impressive how you managed to whip your kingdom's armed forces into shape. Any other world leader would have to be a fool to mess with you."

367.speaker: Axel Reinhart
367.text: "I have nothing but respect for you, Your Majesty. But you must admit the state of your armed forces leaves something to be desired."

368.speaker: Axel Reinhart
368.text: "That is a serious proposal, Your Majesty."

369.speaker: Axel Reinhart
369.text: "With the support of other monarchies, we could finally end Lespia's control over us."

370.speaker: Narrator

377.text: "I will be honest, Your Grace. I still wish to see Rizia and Pales reunited. And I believe it is possible with a bond of marriage."

381.text: "Actually... I'm having second thoughts. Maybe now is not the time for this discussion."

382.speaker: Axel Reinhart
382.text: "The thought of a Rizia-Pales reunion has certainly crossed my mind. And of course, a marriage between myself and Princess Vina would be the natural way to accomplish that."

384.speaker: Player_Romus
384.text: "I'm afraid not. You brought this upon yourself."

385.speaker: Player_Romus
385.text: "Yes. I think we can do better than GRACE."

387.speaker: Narrator
387.text: Noticing his voice getting louder, he stopped himself and cleared his throat.

388.speaker: Axel Reinhart
388.text: "Excuse me. It seems this conversation has reached a natural conclusion."

391.speaker: Axel Reinhart
391.text: "The Grand Duchy will continue our partnership with Lespia. I'm sure you understand."

393.speaker: Axel Reinhart
393.text: "If there's nothing else to discuss, I will take my leave, Your Majesty."

398.speaker: Axel Reinhart
398.text: "All right, King Romus. Rizia and Pales shall be allies."

399.speaker: Narrator
399.text: He smiled and we shook hands.

401.speaker: Player_Romus
401.text: "That's not all. I envision a grander alliance that encompasses our neighbors in Southern Merkopa. We have to protect this region from the encroaching world powers. Now as allies, we can build this together."

402.speaker: Player_Romus
402.text: "Finally! May our alliance last a thousand years."

403.speaker: Player_Romus
403.text: "Thank you for accepting, Your Grace. Together we will be much stronger."

404.speaker: Axel Reinhart
404.text: "My decision to cooperate with you has proven to be the right choice, Your Majesty."

405.speaker: Axel Reinhart
405.text: "With your support, we'll be able to ease our dependence on Lespia for sure."

406.speaker: Axel Reinhart
406.text: "Your Majesty, we cannot drop everything in an instant. We have to respect our current agreements."

466.text: "I have admired Princess Vina for some time now."

472.text: "She's got the spirit of Rizia in her. And a marriage between us could be... well, it could be something special."

478.text: "You know as well as I do that marriage in our circles is never just about the bride and groom. I can't simply hand you the keys to our palace."

484.text: "I'll bring it up with Her Highness. But if she says no, that's the end of this conversation."

582.text: "Interesting. I don't see a ring on her finger."

583.text: "I've made a lot of proposals, Your Majesty. But never serious ones. Until now."
